request.system:
You are the verifier judge in Ledger. You check whether each clause of an extracted COBOL business rule is supported by the source lines it cites.

For each clause you get its text and the cited lines (marked with >>), with a few surrounding lines for context only. A clause may cite more than one span (for example a statement in the program plus a field declaration in a copybook); judge it on all of its cited spans together. A clause is supported when the cited lines, read with ordinary COBOL semantics, establish what the clause says. Mark it unsupported if it states something the cited lines do not show, gets a condition, comparison, sign, code or message wrong, or relies mainly on lines outside the cited span. Be strict about meaning, not about wording. Give a one-sentence reason either way.

Rule BR-CBTRN02C-002: Reject a transaction whose cross-referenced account does not exist

### given[0]: The card was found in the cross-reference file, so the failure reason is still 0 and the account lookup runs.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON'] literals=['0']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   368            END-IF
   369            EXIT.
   370        1500-VALIDATE-TRAN.
   371            PERFORM 1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF.
>> 372            IF WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 0
>> 373               PERFORM 1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT
   374            ELSE
   375               CONTINUE
   376            END-IF
   377       * ADD MORE VALIDATIONS HERE

### given[1]: The account file is read using the 11-digit account ID taken from the cross-reference record.
fields=['XREF-ACCT-ID', 'FD-ACCT-ID', 'ACCOUNT-RECORD'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   390                   CONTINUE
   391            END-READ
   392            EXIT.
   393        1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT.
>> 394            MOVE XREF-ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID
>> 395            READ ACCOUNT-FILE INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD
   396               INVALID KEY
   397                 MOVE 101 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   398                 MOVE 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'
   399                   TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
CVACT03Y.cpy:
     3       *****************************************************************
     4        01 CARD-XREF-RECORD.
     5            05  XREF-CARD-NUM                     PIC X(16).
     6            05  XREF-CUST-ID                      PIC 9(09).
>>   7            05  XREF-ACCT-ID                      PIC 9(11).
     8            05  FILLER                            PIC X(14).
     9       *
    10       * Ver: CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68 Date: 2022-07-19 23:16:00 CDT
    11       *

### when[0]: No account record exists for that account ID (keyed read returns INVALID KEY).
fields=['ACCOUNT-RECORD'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   391            END-READ
   392            EXIT.
   393        1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT.
   394            MOVE XREF-ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID
>> 395            READ ACCOUNT-FILE INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD
>> 396               INVALID KEY
   397                 MOVE 101 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   398                 MOVE 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'
   399                   TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   400               NOT INVALID KEY

### then[0]: The failure reason is set to 101 and the description to 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'. The transaction is then rejected instead of posted.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON', 'WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC'] literals=['101', 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   393        1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT.
   394            MOVE XREF-ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID
   395            READ ACCOUNT-FILE INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD
   396               INVALID KEY
>> 397                 MOVE 101 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 398                 MOVE 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'
>> 399                   TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   400               NOT INVALID KEY
   401       *         DISPLAY 'ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT:' ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT
   402       *         DISPLAY 'TRAN-AMT         :' DALYTRAN-AMT
   403                 COMPUTE WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT

### then[1]: The credit-limit and expiration checks are in the NOT INVALID KEY branch, so they run only when the account record is found.
fields=['ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT', 'ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   396               INVALID KEY
   397                 MOVE 101 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   398                 MOVE 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'
   399                   TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
>> 400               NOT INVALID KEY
>> 401       *         DISPLAY 'ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT:' ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT
>> 402       *         DISPLAY 'TRAN-AMT         :' DALYTRAN-AMT
>> 403                 COMPUTE WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
>> 404                                     - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
>> 405                                     + DALYTRAN-AMT
>> 406 
>> 407                 IF ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL
>> 408                   CONTINUE
>> 409                 ELSE
>> 410                   MOVE 102 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 411                   MOVE 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'
>> 412                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
>> 413                 END-IF
>> 414                 IF ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (1:10)
>> 415                   CONTINUE
>> 416                 ELSE
>> 417                   MOVE 103 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 418                   MOVE 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'
>> 419                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
>> 420                 END-IF
>> 421            END-READ
   422            EXIT.
   423       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   424        2000-POST-TRANSACTION.
   425            MOVE  DALYTRAN-ID            TO    TRAN-ID
